correctness.rationale: Every oriented edge subset F is VC-shattered precisely when its undirected graph is a forest, by cyclic-orientation obstruction and topological extension. K2,3 has exactly 3^3+3^3-2^3=46 acyclic orientation concepts and hence no depth-six shattered tree; certificate.json is a 31-node complete depth-five tree with 32 pairwise different valid witnesses, checked by graph-topological-sort Python and independent C++ cycle logic. Acyclic-orientation product decomposition over bridges, elementary Littlestone product additivity and VC forest rank prove the exact unbounded family. Both original verifiers were executed successfully.

value.rationale: A sharp first separation at five vertices among bipartite graph orientation classes is tied to a genuine structural transition from pseudoforests to two overlapping cycles. A 46-word explicit tree demonstrates the nontrivial adaptive advantage, while bridge additivity amplifies it to arbitrary gap s on connected planar bipartite maximum-degree-three graphs. This is a natural infinite structural separation, not an arbitrary table entry or a routine restatement of the VC forest rank.
